This grassland is surrounded by small rivers to the south, west and north, and to the east is a short soil slope with some trees. There are only two exits in the southeast and northeast directions. So I deliberately created the illusion of escaping from another direction, and slipped out of the gap while they were not paying attention. When they saw me escaping again, they chased me again, shouting one by one: "Slave, surrender quickly! "It seems they take chasing me as a pleasure.

I thought that if I chased her back and forth like this, I would be caught up by them sooner or later. When I sailed the boat to the island in the middle of the lake, they all gathered around me. Now I was surrounded tightly and there was no possibility of escape except to escape to the island.

Since the land and water of Xisha Island are connected, it was easy for me to get on Xisha Island, and they followed me. They tied up all the boats with iron ropes, and three people were watching to prevent me from escaping in the boat. The others chased me on the island.

Xisha Island is surrounded by some sandy land with good quality, but there is a hill in the middle with dense trees. I decided to hide on the hill. I ran towards the mountain quickly. They were chasing after him from below. The mountain was not high, so I reached the top of the mountain quickly, but there was no place to hide on the top of the mountain, so I ran down in the other direction. The other side of the mountain is larger and longer than this side. I passed a long and narrow path that was almost obscured by tall grass on both sides, and found that there was a cave here. There was a wooden bridge at the end of the path, and on the other side of the bridge was an ancient Chinese courtyard. I thought that I could still see Chinese scenery here, and the designer must be from China.

The courtyard is a circular arch. I hurriedly fled to the courtyard. There was a big pavilion in the courtyard. Behind the yard is a bamboo forest. There seemed to be a path in the bamboo forest. I got into the bamboo forest and walked along the path. I found that there was a cave inside, and there was a courtyard behind. The door of this courtyard was also a long and narrow door, which could only fit one person through.

The yard inside is actually larger than the yard outside. There is a rockery inside. There are some passages up and down, left and right, and some caves in the rockery. Next to the rockery, there is also a pavilion, which is slightly larger than the one in the yard outside. Facing the rockery is a house, but this house is a typical European building. It seems that this place is a combination of Chinese and Western.

I decided to hide in this yard to avoid them. I thought it would be difficult for them to chase me here. When they can't find me, they will leave automatically.

Unexpectedly, not long after, I heard voices outside. The sound got louder and louder, and it felt like we were entering the yard in front.

I quickly got into a relatively hidden cave and hid. After a while, I heard voices outside. It must be that they didn't find me in the front yard and came to the back yard to search for me. I held my breath nervously, for fear that they would catch me.

I couldn't see how many people came in, but I felt there were a lot of them, and soon they excluded places other than the rockery. They started searching for the rockery, and I just hoped they couldn't find me.

I heard someone talking above me, someone must have been standing on the rock above me. I was at her feet.

They searched inside the rockery for a while and finally found me. They shouted towards the cave where I was: "You bitch, climb out quickly. Otherwise we will throw things into it."

I had no choice but to climb out. As soon as I climbed out, several beautiful girls kicked me to the ground and stepped on me with countless feet.

I quickly opened my mouth, and as soon as I opened my mouth, she inserted her shoelaces and feet into my mouth. There was also a pretty girl who stepped on my forehead with her shoes.

I tried to push her shoe out of my mouth, but my hands were pressed to the ground again. There is nothing we can do, let them ravage us.

When we reached the winding bamboo path, they unfolded themselves one behind the other, allowing me to crawl under their crotches.

I looked up and saw that they were standing in a zigzag manner, matching the bamboo forest next to them. The scenery was quite beautiful, and I felt a bit like being abused.

I lay on the ground and slowly crawled under their crotches. I wanted to experience the feeling of crawling under their crotches. You can't experience this taste without experiencing it yourself. After licking the shoes of these two beautiful girls, I continued to crawl forward. When I climbed to the feet of the other two beautiful girls, I consciously stopped and licked their shoes. I am a photography teacher at an art college. There are 36 students in the class, all girls from the acting department, and they are all beautiful. I was very happy in my heart. However, what disappointed me was that the girls in the class were not interested in me and even looked down upon me. They are not interested in this course either, because their interest lies in becoming a good actor. Therefore, few people attend my classes. During the fourth class, I arrived fifteen minutes late due to traffic jam. When I arrived at the teacher's office, the girls were talking to each other and didn't react at all when I came in. I told them that class was in session and asked them to calm down. Unexpectedly, they actually accused me and said that I shouldn't be late. I said, you won’t attend the class anyway, what will happen if I’m late? This sentence made them angry, and they all wanted me to apologize. When I saw it, I had to apologize to them.

Several girls said in unison: "Just say I'm sorry and that's it? No!" I said, "What do you think we should do?" One girl said, "Kneel down and kowtow to us one by one to apologize!" After she finished speaking, other girls responded.

I was very angry and said, "You have gone too far? You want me, an almost middle-aged man, to kowtow to you little girls in their 18s and 19s?" They said together, "If you don't kowtow, we will tell the Academic Affairs Office that you are late."

The regulations of the Academic Affairs Office are very strict. It didn’t matter if I didn’t teach, but I didn’t want to give up this good job. Therefore, the only thing left to do is to beg them.

I said, "Aunts, please let me go. I will let you all score 90 or above in the exam." The girls said together, "No, you have to kneel down and kowtow to us." I said, "Please." The girls said, "No! You must crawl under our feet within one minute, otherwise you will be responsible for the consequences." I was still hesitating, and the girls scolded me together: "Kneel down!" I knelt down involuntarily. They all laughed happily, their sense of conquest was palpable.

The girl in the first row on the right said: "You bitch, crawl over here and kowtow to my grandma first." I had lost myself and had no choice but to crawl to her feet.

"You bitch, call me grandma while you kowtow," the girl ordered. It drives me crazy that a girl of 18 or 19 calls herself grandma when a man twice her age calls herself grandma.

"Are you screaming?" Seeing that I didn't scream, the pretty girl stepped on my head.

There was no other way, so I had to shout "Hello grandma!" and she put her feet down.

Ah, ten! Now I'm dead. But there was no other way, so I had no choice but to kowtow to her nine more times, and then I kowtowed and called her grandma, a total of ten times.

The structure of this classroom is as follows: each student has a desk, four rows horizontally and nine rows vertically. The first girl who asked me to kowtow is on the far right.
